The Planner correctly identified the birth dates (Homi Wadia: 1911-05-22, Andrew Lau: 1960-04-04) in the previous step but failed to perform the basic chronological comparison. The Planner concluded that Andrew Lau (born 1960) was born "first" (earlier) than Homi Wadia (born 1911), which is logically false as 1911 is earlier than 1960. This represents a failure in the final synthesis step where the agent should have determined that the director of *Hanuman Patal Vijay* was born first.
